priority_rationale: Among seven matched year-month strata, the largest observed gap in common clear block-point counts is 3 to 214 of 300. Prioritize the upper group for the bounded thermal batch. execution: Same paired native-cell block-intercept Stage1, 1000 paired block bootstrap draws, 1/2/4/8km groups; report precision, no new empirical time regression.
